periods.analysis: In Q1, 190 teens took part in winter after-school programs at three centers.
periods.recommendations: Plan summer programs at five centers.

periods.analysis: Participation grew from 190 to 245 as spring programs ran and summer registration opened.
periods.recommendations: Train a peer-mentor cohort for the summer.

periods.analysis: Participation reached 310 in Q3, up from 245 in Q2, with summer sessions at five centers and a 24-teen mentor cohort.
periods.recommendations: Open evening programs at Bayview and North Inlet and add transportation vouchers for Dune Avenue teens.
